title: Unified Element Endow Slots and Forced Skill Element Priority

changes.summary: Unified weapon/armor element slots; last-applied item or skill wins; equipment change clears matching slot.
Normal skill casts no longer cancel element buffs; new weapon/armor endow skills replace only the matching element slot.
Forced/fixed skill element remains authoritative; weapon element slot applies only where skill uses weapon element.
Added Dark Water 12020 with 20-minute Dark weapon endow.
Restored original Dark Water item icon.

notes: No real-browser manual interaction test was performed in the container.
